## Who we are?
##### Few words about us
Przedsiębiorstwo Produkcyjno Handlowo Usługowe „DIMEX” Sp. z o.o. was established in 1990 in Katowice.  
Since the beginning it`s core business was focused on wholesale trade of solid fuels, with specialization in coke.
Despite considerable fluctuations in economic situation, by offering high quality goods, our company was able to build regularly a portfolio of satisfied clients, on the local as well as on the European and global market.
## Our mission
##### Business approach
> #####  **Relations** with our partners are based on the principle of mutual benefit (**_win-win_**), to guarantee successful cooperation oriented on achieving mutual business goals.
We provide high quality safe and reliable services and high quality products, providing our services and constant supply of diverse and wide range of goods both on the European market, as well as the Near and Far East.
![img win win - Home](https://dimex.pl/koks/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/img_win-win.jpg)
![img partnerstwo - Home](https://dimex.pl/koks/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/img_partnerstwo.jpg)
W
e give our partners the opportunity to focus on their core business, thereby becoming a part of their business.
We ensure support of qualified employees, who specialize in specific groups of products, guaranteeing our clients an individual approach.
> ##### Due to the **high flexibility** resulting from multiple sources of supply, regular trade contracts and experience we enable realization of customized orders tailored to their needs.
The relationships with our partners are built on cooperation, mutual support, and with the intent to purchase common objectives. Each of them due to an individual approach and targeting on the their needs achieve particular added value.
![img wartosc - Home](https://dimex.pl/koks/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/img_wartosc.jpg)
## Our partners
##### Who we cooperate with?
We are authorized dealers of the biggest Coking Plants in Poland offering foundry coke and industrial fuel.  
Thanks to long-term agreements we also offer coal and culm.
In regard to trade in natural graphite we are importer of the goods from the Czech Republic, Norway and China.
## Cooperation
##### Why is it worth it?
Long-term cooperation with the biggest coking plants, as well as a multi-annual dealership agreements and exclusiveness, allows us to guarantee our customers a constant and timely delivery of goods with the expected quality parameters. The company has its permanent representatives on the markets of Western and Eastern Europe and Asia.
